lemma adjoint_isometry_apply (v : W) : e.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (e v) = v := by
  have hh := congrArg (fun T : W →L[ℝ] W => T v) e.adjoint_comp_self
  exact hh
findings.problem: The isometry-adjoint identity is left out of the simp interface, so expressions of the canonical reducible form `e.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (e v)` remain unreduced unless callers explicitly name this lemma.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `adjoint_isometry_apply` with `[simp]`, retaining its current orientation from the adjoint applied to the embedded vector to `v`.
findings.benefit: This gives the standard normal form for the adjoint of an isometric embedding and avoids repeated manual rewrites. In this file, `frame_decomposition` explicitly rewrites with the lemma, and `hemisphereInverse_chart` lists it in `simp only`; both uses support that this normalization is wanted.
